annotation.title_clean: 産業用ロボットの使用等の安全基準に関する技術上の指針
annotation.title_en: Technical Guidelines on Safety Standards for the Use of Industrial Robots
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 厚生労働省 (Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare, Japan)
annotation.venue: 厚生労働省 法令・通達 database
named_instruments_referenced: Japan Industrial Safety and Health Act
annotation.summary_en: Japanese technical guideline issued under Article 28(1) of the Industrial Safety and Health Act setting safety standards for selecting, installing, using, inspecting and training workers on industrial robots, to prevent contact accidents. It covers emergency stops, fencing, light curtains, work procedures, inspections and education.
key_provisions_or_claims: Robots must have emergency stops and automatic speed/output reduction in teaching mode.
Employers must prevent contact via fences, light curtains, ropes or monitors.
Written work procedures required for teaching and inspection within the movable range.
Daily pre-work and periodic inspections with records kept three years.
Workers must receive classroom and practical safety education.
